items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Mrs. (KAPLAN ?)' in the context of a house they liked, but the interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing her.

ctx.x: It was our furniture. But they wrote to us in Europe. I liked the house so much I wanted to buy it, but the woman wouldn't sell, Mrs. (KAPLAN ?). But while we were in Europe they
contacted us through our band, the Bank of America that Mrs. (KAPLAN ?) had passed away and her daughter who had charge of the estate, contacted us in Europe to buy the house.
